node.title: L1 official Newton cofactor-window router
node.statement: Let the generated field be F_(p^f), with n=2^m>=2^13, n|p^f-1, p^f<2^256, and official rate. Exact order arithmetic forces p>=3583: the cap first gives p>=257 and ord_8192(p)<=16, hence p=+-1 mod 512; every such integer below 3583 has an explicit factor. The canonical reserve bound then gives ell_0<=ceil(5(p+1)/(4 log_2 p))+1<=p-3174. For a normalized received polynomial of degree h and canonical threshold a_0=k+ell_0-1, if e_0=h-a_0<=p-ell_0, every exact shell a>=a_0 has fixed-cofactor locator-prefix depth d=min(a,h-k)<p. Newton identities therefore give a bijective coordinate change from that locator prefix to the first d power sums. This covers at least excess layers 0<=e_0<=3174, and all received words when p>=n-k. It supplies a typed power-sum Q cell, not prefix flatness or Pade-graph coalescing.
